review_candidates.description: EngRadar / Kontakt Senior Software Engineer Kontakt Kontakt is the employer — EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs. Remote Kraków Full-time Posted today Apply directly → About Kontakt.io Inside health systems, where every second can matter, operations are still spread across dozens of disconnected tools and platforms. Kontakt.io is changing that. We combine proprietary hardware, AI-powered intelligence, and deep integrations with the technology health systems already have in place to build real-time understanding of what's happening across their operations. That intelligence becomes the execution layer care teams have been missing, helping them make smarter decisions and deliver better patient care. Backed by Goldman Sachs and trusted by leading health systems including HCA Healthcare, Sutter Health, AdventHealth, Trinity Health, Northwell Health, Cleveland Clinic, and the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, we’ve more than doubled our revenue and are rapidly scaling with a clear path toward $100M in annual recurring revenue. If you're excited to solve hard problems and help health systems deliver better care, we'd love to meet you! About The Role Kontakt.io is the leading IoT platform for real-time location and telemetry in healthcare. Our systems track hundreds of thousands of assets and people across hospitals and campuses globally — processing billions of BLE events every day through a Kafka-first, cloud-native architecture. Our Edge engineering group owns the part of the platform where the physical world meets the cloud. It's where raw signals from our own devices turn into reliable location — "this infusion pump is in room 512 on floor 5" — and where that location and event data leaves Kontakt.io to reach customer systems, external APIs and partner platforms. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and run the services in this space. You'll work on real-time, high-volume data where correctness matters: when a location is wrong, a nurse walks to the wrong room. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the data and the customer problem, through design and implementation, to keeping them healthy in production. What You'll Work On Real-time feeds that customers and partners build on. Location and event data leaves our platform over REST, gRPC and WebSocket — position feeds, alarms, standards-based adapters — and hospitals connect it to the systems their staff use every day. You'll make sure what they get is correct, on time and easy to integrate with. "Why is it in the wrong room?" When a customer says a pump keeps showing up in the wrong place, the answer is somewhere in device data, the building layout and millions of observations. You'll find it — and tell a configuration problem apart from a bug in our code. Making data quality visible. We'd rather find problems before customers do. You'll build the checks, metrics and dashboards that show how good our data really is. Turning signals into location. BLE and device telemetry in, accurate room- and floor-level location out — in real time, for the rest of the platform. Bringing in data from other platforms. Integrations with third-party location platforms: understanding their protocol, getting their data into our Kafka backbone and keeping it running when the other side misbehaves. What You'll Do Own what you build, start to finish: work out with product what's actually needed, design it, ship it, and watch how it behaves in production Go after the root cause — when something breaks for a customer, use data, logs and metrics to understand why, and fix it so it doesn't come back Build and maintain Java/Spring and Kafka-based services that process real-time BLE and IoT data for many customers at once Use AI tools (Claude Code or similar) for real work — writing and reviewing code, debugging, digging through data, writing docs Write tests you can rely on (Testcontainers, CI with Jenkins / GitHub Actions) Add the metrics and dashboards (Prometheus, Micrometer, Grafana) that tell the team what's really going on Write down your design decisions, so the next person doesn't have to guess Work day to day with Product, Customer Success, Data Platform, SRE and the device teams — the people who see the same problem from the other side Help the team get better through honest code reviews and design discussions What You Have You've built real-time, event-driven or data-heavy services and run them in production Hands-on Kafka Streams (or a similar streaming system) in production — topics and partitions, consumer groups, delivery guarantees, and what to do when consumers fall behind You've taken something from a vague problem to a working production system, and stayed responsible for it afterwards AI coding tools are part of your daily work — and you know where they help and where you need to check them Strong production Java (Spring Boot or similar) You like messy, real-world data: exploring a large dataset, forming a hypothesis, proving it — or proving yourself wrong Good database judgement — MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis or similar — and knowing which one fits which problem Experience running services in the cloud (AWS preferred: EKS, S3, Kinesis); comfortable with containers, Helm and Terraform Clear written and spoken English — we work closely with colleagues in the US Based in Kraków or willing to relocate Bonus Points If You Have Experience with IoT, BLE, RTLS or other location / telemetry systems Experience integrating with third-party platforms or APIs (enterprise infrastructure) gRPC, WebSocket, AsyncAPI, OAuth2 / Keycloak Python or Go for data analysis, tooling and automation Background in healthcare or another environment where reliability really matters Perks & Benefits Hybrid from our Kraków office — at least 2 days a week in the office Meaningful equity in a company scaling fast, with real customers and real revenue Full benefits: private healthcare, benefits platform, Multisport, snacks and lunch in the office Real ownership — your work decides whether care teams find what they're looking for, in hospitals around the world Posted by Kontakt on their own careers page — you apply directly, no recruiter in between.
